summary: Silver Oak Capital's /aviation-finance/ page presents the firm (a London-based debt broker/adviser, not a lender) as an intermediary arranging aircraft finance. Per the search tool's summaries ([a],[b]), the page explains that most aircraft transactions are financed via two principal routes: (1) a secured loan where the borrower takes a facility from a bank secured by a mortgage over the aircraft, or (2) a lease, either an operating lease or a finance lease. It states the firm also provides finance for commercial aircraft. It lists a typical broker fee of 1.50% of the loan amount and indicative terms of up to 90% LTV, a 5-12 year term and quarterly amortising payments; a representative example shows a GBP 25 million loan at up to 90% LTV with a 30% balloon at a rate of 3.00% plus a margin (text truncated in the snippet). The page cites '300+ Lenders'. Search metadata indicates the indexed copy is ~700 days old. The page is part of an aviation cluster with sibling pages for aviation bridging loans, aviation finance & lease advisory and senior secured aircraft finance advisory, plus G650 and Falcon 900 case studies. Full page text, exact headings, FAQ and CTAs were not surfaced.
